title: Stop Chunking Like It's 2022 — Yuval Belfer, AI21 Labs
talk_summary: Yuval Belfer argues chunking isn't dead but is query-dependent, so no single fixed chunk size dominates; he shows an oracle over chunk sizes gains 20-40% recall. His fix is multi-scale indexing: index the corpus at several chunk sizes, retrieve documents from each, and fuse rankings with reciprocal rank fusion (RRF), at 2-5x memory cost but parallelizable latency.

takeaways.what_they_do: Index the same corpus at several chunk/window sizes, query all indexes per query, retrieve whole documents (not chunks) so rankings are comparable, then merge with reciprocal rank fusion.
takeaways.evidence_quote: Why commit to one where we can commit to several?
takeaways.numbers: 20-40% recall gain over best fixed chunk size; 2-5x memory overhead; latency unaffected since retrieval runs in parallel

takeaways.technique: Retrieve whole documents, not chunks, for comparable ranking
takeaways.what_they_do: When fusing across granularities, they return the parent document rather than the chunk so that rankings from different chunk sizes are comparable and can be voted on.
takeaways.evidence_quote: chunks with different sizes are not really comparable, right? So, instead, we opted to do something which is pretty popular these days

takeaways.what_they_do: Before building the system, they ran an oracle experiment (picking the best chunk size per query using known answers) to measure the achievable ceiling and justify the work.
takeaways.evidence_quote: This essentially is the oracle experiment. This is what we wanted to know to see the potential.
takeaways.numbers: Oracle gap of 20-40% recall over any fixed strategy

takeaways.technique: Parallel multi-index retrieval instead of serial re-query
takeaways.what_they_do: They accept extra memory (2-5x) but keep latency flat by issuing all index queries in parallel and fusing cheaply with a simple RRF script.
takeaways.evidence_quote: latency-wise, it doesn't really affect that because you can do all the retrieval part parallelly
takeaways.numbers: 2-5x memory; RRF is a simple script taking little time
